CustomField.description: Set by GR staff on an Account where outreach needs coordinating - typically one with Legislator__c = Yes, which replaced the retired Legislator record type. When checked, any Task or Event logged against the Account by a team other than GR notifies the GR_Team public group. Does not restrict logging - it is a notify-on-touch flag, not a lock. The flag itself is the trigger gate; the flow does not test Legislator__c.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Check this if GR needs to know whenever another team logs an interaction with this legislator. Other teams can still log activity as normal.
CustomField.label: Outreach Sensitivity
